summary: 25 mW DirectPath stereo headphone amplifier: ground-centred outputs from an internal charge pump (no output DC-block caps), 2.3-5.5 V supply, pin-selected gain (-6/0/3/6 dB via G0/G1), EN shutdown. Wired here for single-ended line inputs and -6 dB gain (G0, G1 low). CAUTION: EN, G0 and G1 are rated to HPVDD + 0.3 V absolute maximum (HPVDD is internal, 1.9 V max), so a 3.3 V GPIO must not drive EN directly
